newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hang Lung sees HK mass flat prices up.
newsitem.headline: Hang Lung sees HK mass flat prices up.

text.p: Ronnie Chan, chairman of Hang Lung Development Co Ltd and Amoy Properties Ltd, said he expects Hong Kong's mass residential property market prices to grow 10 percent from now to the end of 1997.
But prices and rentals for luxury residential properties were already near their peaks, he said.
Chan told Reuters mass residential prices would be pulled up by a shortage of supply as the government did not supply enough land.
"This is a matter of supply and demand," he said.
Chan rejected claims that speculative activities were the driving force behind higher market prices.
"Speculators can only affect the market in the short term. In the long run, it's a matter of supply and demand," he said.
On the office sector, Chan expected rentals to be "very steady" and prices to grow "not much higher" this year.
